implementation.previousAlgorithm: await race(CDP Page.close acknowledgement, actual exit); then await race(actual exit, ten-second sleep). A delayed CDP acknowledgement could extend the intended ten-second observation window.
implementation.newAlgorithm: arm ten-second abortable timer first; dispatch close; race deadline and actual exit; CDP acknowledgement itself resolves only by subsequent actual exit, errors still fail; cancel timer in finally. Runner retains child.exitCode === 0 assertion.
limitations: Node timers are not hard-real-time guarantees under blocked event loop or system pressure
only normal shutdown boundary changed; interrupted-scenario fault injection still uses its existing separate close/kill logic
command failure can fail before deadline; no ignored CDP command error
no app.exit, no lifecycle-order or Host/runtime change; forced cleanup remains failure only

cases: acknowledgement without actual exit does not pass
CDP request error fails and cancels timer
actual owned Node child exit0 without CDP acknowledgement
tests.clockScope: controlled Promise clock verifies ordering/no-extension without waiting wall10s; actual copied injected QA exercises real timer
